content: In this paper, we presented a taxonomy of recommendation systems and applications based on LDA of the recent research, including app, travel, friend, location, scientific paper, and music recommendation. Furthermore, we applied LDA algorithm and Gibbs sampling on ISWC and WWW conference's publications from 2013-2017. Generally, recommendation systems can be an impressive interface between online users and websites in the Internet communities. Our study suggest that NLP methods based on LDA can discover hidden aspects to better understanding of the behaviors of the people to build smart recommendation systems in online communities.
